g.text: Offline Training, Runtime Inference, Upstream Telemetry, and Downstream Alerts
FastAPI does not keep one request open forever.
The backend listener receives MQTT messages,
groups readings into windows or batches,
Training is offline on the local machine.
Runtime inference happens later in the backend
ESP32 sends machine telemetry to MQTT/cloud
Backend sends alert/command back to ESP32 and dashboard
Offline local process that creates the model artifact
Repeated backend prediction on incoming windows/batches
USB debugging path before trusting Wi-Fi/MQTT/cloud output
